fields.name: action
fields.coerce: compared with `==` to each string; a falsy value (absent, `""`, `0`, `null`) selects the default
fields.description: What to stop. `"invis"`: your invisibility. `"channeling"`: every channeled action (all of `c`). `"teleport"` and `"town"`: `c.town`. `"revival"`: `c.revival`. Absent: invisibility and every channeled action. Any other value stops nothing.

request.others: ignored. The handler accepts a `null` payload (`!data`) and then uses the default.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: Always when you have a character: also when nothing stopped, and for an unknown `action`.

also.when: The stop ended your invisibility (`step_out_of_invis`). The cooldown is `G.skills.invis.reuse_cooldown` (12,000 ms) plus `penalty_cd` (up to 10,000).

confirm.note: `G.skills.invis` has no `share` and `reuse_cooldown: 12000` in G 17478, so `ms` is `12000 + penalty`

also.name: Invisibility ended
also.when: The stop ended your invisibility, right after `skill_timeout` (`resend` with no flags). It also ends `invincible` (`s.invincible` becomes `{ms: 0}`).

also.name: Stopped
also.summary: Your state with the new `s` and `c`.

order: if invisibility ended: `skill_timeout` `{name: "invis"}`, then `player` to you
